{"verdict":"revise_required","summary":"The diff delivers a genuine deep simplification (~24,000 deletions vs ~3,400 insertions across 143 files): dedicated recovery/reopen/rebind/replay/invalidation machinery is removed (core/task-recovery.mjs, scripts/task-recovery.mjs, scripts/validate-stage-replay.mjs, build-spec-receipt-recovery.mjs, recovery credential/generation schemas, runner-replacement bootstrap schemas, task-migrate-runner-root.mjs), and historical-permit blockers are cut in the right places. Formal safety is largely strengthened rather than weakened: build-code completion now requires a pass verdict or verified closed resolution (requireFinalIntegrationReview), verify-code derives its AC set from the current spec instead of the accepted build-code record and requires tests, review, and quality-review snapshots to all equal the current tree, review-flow identity is keyed to the current snapshot so a material edit starts a fresh flow while still needing a fresh passing review at that tree, and retired invalidation record paths are explicitly rejected by writeRecordAtomic. Five stages, atomic writes, independent review facts (reviews/resolutions still enumerated separately from permissions), confirmation/authorization boundaries, inventory/clean-install/complexity/AC-coverage tooling, and current-tree verification are preserved; clean-install additionally gained a real no-provider released-stage dependency smoke over all five stages. However, several build-code completion guards were relaxed in ways that leave dead or self-satisfying code rather than deliberate, tested semantics: plannedChanges is computed, passed, and type-checked but never used; the claimed-changes/diff equality check is now skipped entirely for natural-language task rows; runtime-authenticated bindings are inserted into the evidence map immediately before the loop that validates that same map, making those iterations vacuous and silently masking a wrong hash cited by a task row; and the executed_commands binding error is now unreachable. These are quality-of-implementation regressions in the completion certifier, not history-permit removals, and they should be resolved or explicitly justified.","findings":[{"severity":"major","path":"core/stage-handlers.mjs","line":null,"issue":"certifyBuildCodeQualityBasis now only compares claimed changes against the authenticated diff when claimedChanges is non-empty (`if (claimedChanges.length > 0 && !sameStringSet(...))`), and certifyCurrentTaskCompletion feeds it an array filtered by the new pathOnlyCompletionClaim(). Any task row whose actual_changes is prose rather than a pure path list contributes nothing, so a completion where every row is descriptive silently skips the tasks.md-vs-diff equality guard altogether.","root_cause":"The relaxation intended to stop descriptive task notes from blocking progress was implemented by emptying the claim set and then making the equality check conditional on that set being non-empty, which converts a fail-closed check into a check that disappears when no row happens to be path-only.","recommendation":"Keep the guard unconditional over the claims that do exist and make the descriptive case explicit: either require at least one path-only claim per completion (or per changed file) and keep exact set equality, or verify that every path mentioned in a prose row is a subset of the authenticated diff. Add a test asserting that an all-prose completion whose rows disagree with the real diff still fails."},{"severity":"major","path":"core/stage-handlers.mjs","line":null,"issue":"certifyCurrentTaskCompletion inserts the runtime-authenticated bindings into `evidence` (tests.receipt_ref/hash, review result/attempt refs, and every requiredEvidence entry) and then iterates `for (const binding of [{ ref: tests.receipt_ref, sha256: tests.receipt_hash }, ...requiredEvidence])` over that same map. Every element checked was just written with the value being compared, so those iterations can no longer fail, and a task row that cited the same ref with a stale or wrong hash is overwritten instead of reported.","root_cause":"The fix for stale self-references (tasks.md updated after the test capture) was applied by pre-populating the verification map rather than by narrowing which bindings task rows are required to cite, leaving the original verification loop in place as dead code.","recommendation":"Drop the now-vacuous loop and state the binding explicitly, or keep the loop and detect conflicts before overwriting: if a task row already maps a ref to a different hash, fail with a clear stale-citation error rather than silently replacing it. Cover both cases with tests."},{"severity":"minor","path":"core/stage-handlers.mjs","line":null,"issue":"`plannedChanges` is computed in certifyCurrentTaskCompletion from the 精确文件/boundary fields, passed to certifyBuildCodeQualityBasis, destructured with a default, and validated (`if (!Array.isArray(plannedChanges)) throw new TypeError(...)`), but it is never read afterwards. It is a dead parameter whose only effect is a type error on misuse.","root_cause":"A planned-boundary cross-check appears to have been introduced as a signature and validation without the corresponding comparison logic, likely because per-row boundary enforcement already happens where paths are extracted.","recommendation":"Either remove plannedChanges from both the computation and the signature, or use it: assert that the authenticated changed files fall within the union of planned boundaries when that union is non-empty, with a test for an out-of-boundary change."},{"severity":"minor","path":"core/stage-handlers.mjs","line":null,"issue":"The executed_commands binding now throws only when `executionMatches.length === 0 && !(tests?.receipt_ref && tests?.receipt_hash && tests.exit_code === 0)`. certifyBuildCodeQualityBasis already rejects any tests whose exit_code is not 0, and the receipt ref/hash are required by the surrounding evidence handling, so this error branch is effectively unreachable and the check reads as active when it is not.","root_cause":"The requirement was disabled by adding a bypass condition that is always satisfied on the only path that reaches it, instead of removing the check and documenting that the authenticated test receipt is the execution fact.","recommendation":"Delete the unreachable branch and rely on the authenticated receipt explicitly, or restore a meaningful obligation (for example requiring the command binding only when no authenticated receipt is present) so the code path can actually fire."},{"severity":"minor","path":"core/task-handle.mjs","line":null,"issue":"validateManifest now accepts execution_mode \"legacy_pinned\" while all validation of runner_root, runner_oid, and runner_root_migration is deleted. A manifest may carry a non-absolute runner_root, a malformed runner_oid, or one field without the other, and bootstrapStage no longer calls assertTaskRunnerIdentity for such tasks (the test was rewritten from \"rejects runner drift\" to \"ignores a legacy pinned runner\").","root_cause":"Retiring runner pinning was implemented by removing the validation block and widening the allowed execution_mode enum, rather than by validating the historical shape on read while refusing to treat it as identity authority.","recommendation":"Since these fields are now inert history, either keep a minimal shape check for legacy_pinned manifests (absolute runner_root, 40-hex runner_oid, fields present together) or reject writing them outright while tolerating them on read, and assert the chosen behavior in core/__tests__/task-handle.test.mjs."},{"severity":"minor","path":"bundle/current-facts.json","line":49,"issue":"final_gates.status is \"passed\" while final_gates.summary.formal_status reads \"current-tree facts bound; final coverage validator pending\", and the supplied acceptance-criteria.md is empty (0 bytes, sha256 e3b0c442...), so the AC-01..AC-15 coverage claims in final_coverage cannot be checked against any criterion text within this bundle.","root_cause":"The gate summary was captured before the final coverage validator completed, and the acceptance-criteria attachment was delivered empty, leaving the coverage question answerable only by oracle/execution refs and not by criterion content.","recommendation":"Re-emit the facts with the coverage validator finished so status and formal_status agree, and include the non-empty acceptance-criteria text so each covered AC can be matched to the oracle that is claimed to exercise it."}]}
